title: 第6078章 见到镇渊侯第6077章 神狱内部寰宇星空
lines: “可你这开启变法……。”
镇渊侯道：“整个朝廷都要震动，按照你的变法，就算是为父这尊帝侯，也已是普通身份。而且，你将是整个黄金神国，古往今来，无数王侯的眼中钉，你可是想好后果了？”
叶寒笑笑，道：“规则与法度是一回事，现实便是另一回事，父亲乃是起源始祖之境的高手，想要踏入众生神榜，自然不过是一念之间，实力毋庸置疑，而且，在昔日乃是主上亲封的帝侯，自然不受到变法的影响。”
随之，叶寒身上的气息，变得冰冷了几分：“但是其他那些王侯，我也给了他们机会，若是他们真有本事，闯入众生榜前列，又有何难？只要进入众生神榜，自然依旧拥有他们的神侯身份，若是无法入榜，那也是自身实力不济，只能怨自己，很公平，若是谁有不爽，尽管来找我。”
“玄儿的性格，为父倒是有些看不透了。”
镇渊侯认真看了叶寒一眼。
叶寒拱手，没有再多说。
这镇渊侯，不愧是聂玄的父亲。
在其面前稍稍多说几句，便已能在不知不觉中，让这镇渊侯感觉不对劲。
当然了，这也是叶寒如今未曾刻意隐藏的缘故。
时至今日，在心灵深处，叶寒对身份暴露这件事，已然是不需要和以前一样，那般谨慎了。
而且，论实力，现在的叶寒，即便和镇渊侯有差距，那般差距也不大了。
而这个差距的前提是，镇渊侯坐镇在渊州，能够得到整个渊州的加持。
类似此刻在这诸天神狱之中，真正打起来，倘若是生死大战，叶寒当然能和斩杀元气侯一样，同样击败镇渊侯。
“对了，父亲。”
“你们五位帝侯，进入这诸天神狱已有不短的时间。”
“诸天神狱内部，究竟出现什么事情，居然至今不能回归而去？”
叶寒改变了话音，好奇询问。
“罢了！”
“如今你已是当世监国，关于这诸天神狱的一些事情，让你知晓倒也无妨。”
镇渊侯道：“这神狱，建立太过漫长的岁月，本身已没有当初牢固，前些日子，第七层诸天产生诸般未知的变化，似乎有神秘力量，要出手干预诸天神狱的一切，以至于让这神狱内部的无数高手产生动乱，甚至，神狱本身都出现了裂痕……。”
许久，镇渊侯的话语落下。
叶寒这才知晓，诸天神狱发生了什么。
原来最初，是诸天神狱内部，一些绝世高手开启动乱，居然对这神狱之中，属于黄金神国的高手展开猎杀，妄图杀出神狱，逃出生天。
几大帝侯被派遣而来，自然是亲自前来镇压动乱的。
然而，神狱本身居然出现裂痕。
这就让进入神狱的五大帝侯，不得不暂时留在其中，妄图动用种种手段来将这神狱的裂痕修复。
只是，纵然是五大帝侯亲自坐镇、亲自出手，想要短时间内修复神狱的裂痕，也做不到。
只能够长期坐镇在其中。
此刻，这镇渊侯所盘坐之地，这祭坛下方，便是一处空间裂隙，神狱裂痕。
若是没有一尊帝侯在此地坐镇，其他神国的各种高手，根本就束手无策。
这般裂痕，若是不及时修复，未来只会无限扩散，导致有朝一日整个诸天神狱彻底裂开，简直是后果不堪设想。
至于黄金之主那边……
黄金之主纵然是诸天第一高手，天下无敌，然而依旧不可能是全知全能的存在。
content_en:
"But you started the reform..."
Marquis Zhenyuan said: "The entire court will be shaken. According to your reform, even your father, the emperor, will have an ordinary status. Moreover, you will be the thorn in the eyes of countless princes throughout the Golden Kingdom. Have you thought about the consequences?"
Ye Han smiled and said: "Rules and laws are one thing, but reality is another. My father is a master in the realm of the ancestors. Naturally, it is just a thought to step into the list of gods. There is no doubt about his strength. Moreover, in the past, he was an emperor personally named by the Lord, so naturally he will not be affected by the reform."
Then, the aura on Ye Han's body became a bit colder: "But I also gave the other princes a chance. If they really have the ability to break into the top of the list of living beings, what's the difficulty? As long as they enter the list of living beings, they will naturally still have their status as god princes. If they can't enter the list, it's because they are not strong enough and can only blame themselves. It's fair. If anyone is unhappy, just come to me."
"Xuan'er's character is something that a father can't quite see through."
Marquis Zhenyuan took a serious look at Ye Han.
Ye Han cupped his hands and said nothing more.
This Marquis of Zhenyuan is worthy of being Nie Xuan's father.
Just saying a few words in front of him could unconsciously make Marquis Zhenyuan feel that something was wrong.
Of course, this is also the reason why Ye Han has not deliberately hidden it now.
Today, deep in his heart, Ye Han no longer needs to be as cautious about revealing his identity as before.
Moreover, in terms of strength, even if there is a gap between Ye Han and Marquis Zhenyuan now, the gap is not that big.
The premise of this gap is that Zhenyuanhou is sitting in Yuanzhou and can get the blessing of the entire Yuanzhou.
Similar to the real fight at this moment in the prison of gods, if it was a life and death battle, Ye Han would certainly be able to defeat Zhen Yuan Hou just like he killed Yuan Qi Hou.
"That's right, Father."
"You five emperors have been in this heavenly prison for quite some time."
"What happened inside the Heavenly Prison and why you are still unable to return?"
Ye Han changed his tone and asked curiously.
"That's it!"
"Now that you are the current Supervisor, there is no harm in letting you know some things about this heavenly prison."
Marquis Zhenyuan said: "This divine prison has been established for too long, and it is no longer as strong as it was at the beginning. A few days ago, various unknown changes occurred in the seventh-level heavens. It seems that there is a mysterious force that wants to intervene in everything in the divine prison, so that countless masters inside the divine prison are in turmoil. There are even cracks in the divine prison itself..."
After a long time, Marquis Zhenyuan finished his words.
Only then did Ye Han know what happened in the Heavenly Prison.
It turns out that in the beginning, some peerless masters started to cause chaos inside the Divine Prison of the Heavens. They actually hunted the masters belonging to the Golden Divine Kingdom in this Divine Prison in an attempt to break out of the Divine Prison and escape.
Several great emperors were dispatched, and naturally they came to suppress the turmoil in person.
However, cracks appeared in the divine prison itself.
This forced the five emperors who entered the Divine Prison to stay in it temporarily, trying to use various means to repair the cracks in the Divine Prison.
However, even if the five emperors personally took charge and took action, they could not repair the cracks in the Divine Prison in a short time.
You can only sit in it for a long time.
At this moment, where Zhen Yuanhou was sitting cross-legged, under the altar, there was a space crack, a crack in the divine prison.
If there is no emperor sitting here, the various masters from other divine kingdoms will be helpless.
If such cracks are not repaired in time, they will only spread indefinitely in the future, leading to the complete cracking of the entire prison of gods one day, with unimaginable consequences.
As for the Lord of Gold...
Even though the Lord of Gold is the greatest master in the world and invincible, he still cannot be omniscient and omnipotent.
title_en: Chapter 6078 Meeting Marquis Zhenyuan Chapter 6077 The Starry Sky Inside the Divine Prison
